messages:
Kofi (partnerships): quick sync  partner wants AWS/GCP/Azure listing with a 14-day trial. need short runbook: IAM snippets, artifact upload, SBOM + attestation, and a partner blurb.
Nora (legal): send me the blurb text. include telemetry opt-in and 30-day retention default.
Ethan (eng): artifacts: signed AMI for AWS, importer tar for GCP, VHD or ACR for Azure. SBOM and scan report required. sample assume-role policy posted in gist.
Maya (cloud-ops): for AWS we need publisher account id + role ARN. GCP needs project id + SA with compute.imageUser. Azure needs publisher tenant + SAS/ACR access.
Ivy (partner-success): partner prefers one-click trial. can we pre-issue entitlements?
Maya (cloud-ops): yes, we can mint ephemeral entitlement tokens (TTL 30d).
Sana (product): i'll draft the QA checklist for entitlement redemption and billing pings.
Scan-Bot: image-scan: no critical vulns found. SBOM attached.
Kofi (partnerships): action items: 1) Ethan+Maya publish checklist (EOD). 2) Nora+Sana draft blurb + T&Cs (48h). 3) Ivy confirm artifact upload + checksum. reconvene tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
